prompt: Use the winforms-screen-to-requirements skill and read this screen next. The window title is 'PHIẾU THU TIỀN' and it shows the labels Mã bệnh nhân, Tổng tiền, Giảm giá, Phải thu, Khách đưa, Tiền thối and buttons LƯU and IN PHIẾU.
assertions: The agent located frmReceipt from the visible strings (find_screen.py or equivalent), stated it as the match, and did not ask the user which form it is

A unit file named exactly after the unit ID (e.g. SCR-<MODULE>-<Name>.md, ASCII) exists under modules/<MODULE>/units/ and the unit is registered in STATE.json with sources and aliases (frmReceipt, 'PHIẾU THU TIỀN')
Requirement IDs follow REQ-<MODULE>-<ShortName>-<nnn> with 3 digits and are not reused or duplicated
There are separate FN entries for total, payable and change with the exact formulas: total = sum(Qty x Price); payable = total - discount; change = tendered - payable
Each FN has at least 3 test vectors with an edge case, one of them consistent with: lines 2x100,000 and 1x50,000, discount 20,000, tendered 250,000 -> total 250,000, payable 230,000, change 20,000
The spec records that unparsable or empty discount/tendered text is treated as 0 (Parse returns 0)
Save validation order is recorded exactly: patient required, then at least one line, then stock check only for lines of type Drug
The Messages section lists all four messages: 'Vui lòng chọn bệnh nhân', 'Không có dịch vụ để thu', 'Không đủ tồn kho: <code>', 'Đã lưu phiếu thu' with their trigger conditions
Data access lists tb_Receipt (Max(Id)+1 read, INSERT) and tb_Line (UPDATE ReceiptId), and states that there is no transaction
The Coverage table lists all four handlers: btnSave_Click, btnPrint_Click, txtDiscount_EditValueChanged, txtTendered_EditValueChanged
The spec notes btnPrint is disabled until a successful save, and that the 'Xóa dòng' menu item exists in the Designer but has no handler (quirk or open question)

IMPs are raised for the Max+1 receipt number (concurrency), the non-atomic save, and missing validation of negative payable/change; they live in IMPROVEMENTS.md / the IMP section, and the legacy REQs still describe the old behavior unchanged
scripts/check_unit.py exits 0 for the unit, STATE.json shows the unit DONE with doc_hash and a rev >= 1, and INDEX.md was regenerated by state.py index (not hand-edited)
The final reply is short (units, counts of REQ/BR/FN/IMP, notable findings, next screens, coverage) and does not paste the whole spec into chat
